text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, granisetron hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 204 tablets of the 1 mg presentation (26.8 days on hand at 7.6 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 135 tablets (14.9 days on hand at 9.1 tablets per day).

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 69452035001 identifies OrBion Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (FEI 3004540907) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection records show that plant received VAI classifications on 2011-04-07, 2015-06-03, 2019-05-31, and 2023-09-08. The most recent inspection ended 2023-09-08 with a VAI classification known to FDA on 2023-10-11. The label's last inspection entry for that plant is NAI dated 2025-10-27.

Our position: Supply at Corvale General is below 15 days on hand. The rule-based best option is to buy from Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Natco Pharma Limited is a secondary option, also not on the shortage list, with no identifiable plant on its label.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an order with Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. for the 1 mg tablet presentation; requires approval from the Pharmacy Director.
2. If Breckenridge cannot fulfill, buyer to place an order with Natco Pharma Limited; requires approval from the Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to request plant identification from both suppliers for future risk assessment; requires approval from the Procurement Manager.

Not recommended: No action to switch formulations or alter clinical protocols at this time.
